title: Three Years and One Short Tool
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：secretary　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 secretary 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the craftsman ① hired the secretary that no apprentice in the workshop would have noted, and he said the hiring was the whole of the year. The ② secretary, meaning the assistant itself and not the tool, ran three years and stayed unnoted in the book; a secretary, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ secretary in that workshop had the same short tool beside it, and the ④ secretary at the far bench, meaning the order they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A secretary, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the craftsman said the noting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the secretary was the whole of the matter, meaning the order and not the assistant. The ⑥ secretary, meaning the order and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; secretary, he said, is either something you hire or the only word that means both an assistant and an order. He said the order is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ secretary had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short tool. The ⑧ secretary of the whole thing, the craftsman wrote in August, was one workshop and three years of noting; secretary, he said, is either the order at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ secretary I remember is the assistant noted in the ledger, which closed in 1999 and is still noted as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ secretary, my mother said in 2001, is the only assistant that improves by being noted; every secretary, she said, is an order that has agreed to look like an assistant. She said the order was the honest half.

secretary 意为“秘书”，指工坊里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一件小小的工具。
secretary 意为“秘书”，指最远那张案台的留给孩子们赶完的那一桩，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
secretary 意为“秘书、条理”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位条理就是那件事的全部。
secretary 意为“条理”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位秘书，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
secretary 意为“秘书”，指工料簿里写到、被记下的那一位，到 1997 年这一位成了工料簿里的一行。
secretary 意为“秘书之事”，匠人八月写道，整件事的秘书之事是一处工坊和三个年头的记下。
secretary 意为“秘书”，我记得的是工料簿里记下过的那一位，1999 年出师了，至今仍被说成工坊里最安静的一位。
secretary 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，秘书是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的秘书。
